settingsView.title: Settings
settingsView.subtitle: Control what Replica keeps on this computer.
settingsView.retentionDescription: Scans older than this are removed from History, along with saved file hashes that haven't been seen since. Rescans of those folders will hash files again.
settingsView.retentionNote: Removed files that can still be restored are never deleted by this setting. They stay in History under "Other removed files".
settingsView.saveSuccessMessage: Past scans will be kept for {{retention}}.
settingsView.saveSuccessPruned_one: Past scans will be kept for {{retention}}. Removed {{count}} older scan.
settingsView.saveSuccessPruned_other: Past scans will be kept for {{retention}}. Removed {{count}} older scans.
settingsView.saveErrorMessage: Something went wrong while saving. Please try again.

scanView.title: Find duplicate files and free up space on your computer.
scanView.support: Replica is a desktop app that scans images, videos, PDFs, documents, and more — entirely on your machine.
scanView.readyToScan: Folder selected — you can start the scan

resultsView.title: Duplicate files
resultsView.empty: Run a scan from the Scan page to find duplicate files in a folder.
resultsView.noDuplicates: No duplicate files were found in this folder. Everything looks unique.
resultsView.reusedHashes: Reused {{reused}} saved hashes from earlier scans, hashed {{computed}} new or changed files.
resultsView.selectAllNote: Selects all but one copy per cluster, keeping the original.
resultsView.deleteSuccessMessage: {{count}} file(s) were moved to recovery. You can restore them from History.
resultsView.deleteErrorMessage: Something went wrong while removing files. Please try again.

desktop.title: Desktop App
desktop.description: Installed on your Mac or PC. Scanning runs on your computer — no browser tab, no cloud, and no account required.

detection.title: Content-Based Detection
detection.description: Files are hashed on your device. Duplicates are matched by content, not filename, for accurate results.

review.title: You Stay in Control
review.description: Review every duplicate group before removing anything. Selected files go to a local recovery folder so you can restore them later.

historyView.title: History
historyView.subtitle: Review past scans and restore files you removed.
historyView.empty: Run a scan and remove duplicates to see them here.
historyView.noDeletesForScan: No files were removed from this scan.
historyView.restoreSuccessMessage: {{count}} file(s) were restored to their original locations.
historyView.restoreErrorMessage: Something went wrong while restoring files. Please try again.

folderSelector.title: Choose a folder to scan
folderSelector.description: Browse your computer and pick a folder to scan for duplicates.
folderSelector.localNote: All scanning happens locally. Your files are never uploaded or sent over the internet.
